name: mercury-ops
description: Oforica-scoped Mercury Banking read+write MCP (API token REST). Spend tools gated off until MERCURY_OPS_ALLOW_SPEND=1. Stock Cursor Mercury OAuth stays OG Holdings-only. Do not publish to Marketplace.

MERCURY_API_TOKEN.title: Mercury API token
MERCURY_API_TOKEN.description: Token from Mercury dashboard → Settings → Tokens. Include the secret-token: prefix. Send Money (createTransaction) needs an IP whitelist; request-send-money / request-transfer-money use the approval queue and may not. Never commit or paste this into chat.

MERCURY_OPS_ALLOW_SPEND.title: Allow spend tools
MERCURY_OPS_ALLOW_SPEND.description: Leave unset. Set to 1 only after Jim explicitly enables spend. Until then, send_money / request_send_money / transfer_money / request_transfer_money are hidden from tools/list. Human approval still lives outside this connector.
